items.evidence: The acceptance test passes. A judge-side counter that tallies raw actions and does not use style-stats was compared with the CLI's printed Style lines. They matched exactly after rounding on seed 42 (2000 hands, mixed) and seed 7 (3000 hands, mixed), and also on no-lineup 6-max, tough 9-max, soft 6-max, mixed heads-up, mixed sng and no-lineup 10-max sng. The no-lineup 10k run prints 'Style: TAG, 60000 hands'. The user seat is excluded.
The unit test passes. Mutants that count the user seat, count violating hands or ignore missing lineUp were all killed. The grep shows no own bet/raise/call counting except the advice classification.
The worked-example test asserts 50.0% and not 60.0%. A mutant that adds preflop raises to aggression was killed.

The acceptance test passes. Judge check with a hand-built band table: values just outside print exact 'Outside band: <style> <stat> v% (band lo-hi%)' lines, in style order then stat order, with exit 1 and 'Style check: failed' directly before Bot results. A mutant that ignores the style verdict in the exit code was killed.

Judge check on a mixed seed-77 run: every value sits exactly on a band edge (low edge, high edge, or both) and gives no Outside band lines. Moving TAG VPIP low +0.1, Maniac PFR high -0.1 and Rock aggression low +0.1 gives exactly 3 Outside band lines and exit 1. Mutants that make either edge exclusive were killed.

Judge checks of formatStyleReport: 17.95% passes, 17.94% fails, 26.0% passes, 26.05% fails, and roundStat(null) is null. A null aggression prints 'Outside band: TAG aggression — (band 45.0-65.0%)'. When every hand violates, the checked run prints 'Style check: failed, no bot hands were counted' and exits 1, and the unchecked run prints no block. Mutants for unrounded comparison, null passing, empty counts passing and map-order output were killed.

The acceptance test passes. The judge's own mixed-spot classifier, fed by the runner's action hook, matched the CLI's Mixed spot lines exactly on 8 runs, with 0 actions that were neither recommended nor alternative. The 20-hand 3-max tough run prints 0/0 spots and does not fail on them. A custom onAction and the built-in checkStep both still run under --check-styles: an engine seam that corrupts stacks gives 24 violations both with and without the flag.

The unit test passes. Mutants that count alternative===null cells, count unmarked spots, keep the buffer across violating hands or fail 0/0 were all killed. One mutant survived, counting any other action type as 'alternative' (see the LOW finding).

Through the npm entry: a duplicate flag, --help with the flag and --replay-code with the flag each exit 2 with the exact message and USAGE on stderr. '--check-styles=1' and '--check-style' exit 2 with 'Error: unknown option.'. --help shows the new 5th line. The Options echo ends with ' --check-styles'. Mutants for the echo and the replay check were killed.

findings.expected_vs_actual: A-4 says that, in a mixed spot, an action that is neither the recommended move nor the alternative is not counted. Production code behaves this way. However, changing it to count such actions as 'alternative' leaves every test passing, so the rule is unguarded.
findings.fix: Add a unit case where a recorded preflop step in a mixed unopened cell uses a third action type (e.g. fold when the advice is raise/call), and assert that both counts stay unchanged.

findings.expected_vs_actual: With --check-styles, the built-in invariant checks must still run (composeChecks(seams.onAction ?? checkStep, recorder)). The behaviour is correct: a corrupted-state run reports the same violations with and without the flag. But dropping checkStep from the composition in the checked path leaves every test passing.
findings.fix: Add a test that a --check-styles run still reports a built-in invariant violation (e.g. via an engine seam that corrupts a state).

summary: All 14 SPEC items PASS. npm test passes (947/0) and CI is green. The 3x100k slow check passes on all seeds. The spec's Run command passes end to end. The judge's independent counter matches the CLI's printed stats and mixed-spot counts exactly on two seeds and six other configurations. Band edges are inclusive and one tenth outside fails with the correct line and exit 1. Replay output is unchanged. The SHAs match the build log. 21 of 23 mutants were killed. The 2 survivors are test-coverage gaps where the behaviour itself is correct (LOW). No blocking findings.
